Ivy (finance): Alert from nightly: east-2 GPU burst caused a $5.6k unexpected line on invoice. Around 30% unlabeled. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/costs/east2-burst :eyes:
BillingBot: [ALERT] invoice-ingest: unexpected_spike=true project=perf-loadtest-east2 unlabeled_percent=30.4% :rotating_light:
Noah (finops): Can we map by start_time and instance_id to decide if this was a scheduled load test or accidental churn?
Zoe (eng-platform): We ran a scheduled perf run at 02:00 using the perf-loadtest worker pool. The job should include labels team=platform,test=perf but older runners missed label injection for about 90 minutes after the deploy.
Ravi (eng-ml): We also had a short diag run that may have used the same pool briefly. I can check job IDs, but platform likely owns most.
Ivy (finance): Quick BQ extract posted: https://files.redwood.ai/fin/1769999999-east2-burst.csv. Preliminary match suggests $4.1k matches the scheduled perf run, $1.5k unlabeled.
Noah (finops): Proposal: retroassign $4.1k to eng-platform; split $1.5k unlabeled 80/20 platform/eng-ml based on run-time distribution. Need signoff from platform and eng-ml.
Zoe (eng-platform): Platform accepts $4.1k and the 80/20 split for the remainder. We'll also add a strict pre-deploy check to ensure runner label propagation and an alert if pool_label_null > 5% for >30m.
Ravi (eng-ml): Eng-ml accepts the $300 portion. I'll provide job IDs and timestamps for the diag run.
Ivy (finance): Approved. Ivy to post ledger journal: note=1769999999_east2_burst_reassign. Please attach job evidence.
BillingBot: Task TSK-1345 created: "east2-burst-backfill + ledger entry" assigned to finance + eng-platform + eng-ml.
